_: Editorial for hat-tan-cursive. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-hat.json.
_specs: Nothing about construction is published for the hats. The family file marks fabric and care as needing spec; nothing is invented here.
buyBody: The script in tan. The warmest thing in the range and the one that looks least like golf equipment, which for a lot of people is the point.
pieceHeadline: The one that doesn't look like golf
pieceParas: Tan is an odd color for a golf hat and that is exactly why it works. It sits with everything, it does not read as sportswear, and it is the one that gets worn on days nobody is playing.
Script across the front, same as the white Cursive. Different hat entirely once the color changes.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, off-course. Warm light, warm background. This one earns its place away from the course, so the shot should not be on a tee box. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
